research_scope: Time Skip/Flash Skewer — Strike Super / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.repository_history_search: No prior research commit found for this skill.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2 reference classifies Time Skip/Flash Skewer as a Strike Super and Counter Skill; canonical identity is Super / Strike.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Training with Hit; Hit's Initiation Test is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Future Warrior can learn the skill; usable_by_cac true.
verification_audit.finish_policy: Instructor-training acquisition, not a PQ reward; ultimate_finish_required is false.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The user enters a defensive stance and counters a front-side Strike hit. The current Xenoverse 2 reference describes short-range, single-hit behavior and reports approximately 5% initial damage with follow-up opportunities. Historical community documentation reports a later rework affecting blockability, so guard interaction remains version-sensitive.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Super Pack 1 is the correct DLC context for Hit's mentor skills. A conflicting Dragon Ball Wiki description labels it as Super Pack 2, but the Hit mentor listing and Super Pack 1 skill set identify Super Pack 1.
evidence_limits: Exact active frames, hitbox/range, current damage, and current guard interaction require direct game testing.

records.name: Time Skip/Flash Skewer
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: Documented acquisition is Hit instructor training rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
records.skill_description: Time skip and attack an opponent in front of you.
records.mechanics_notes: Defensive stance counters a front-side Strike hit. The current Xenoverse 2 reference describes short-range, single-hit behavior and approximately 5% initial damage with follow-up opportunities. Its page labels the move unblockable, while historical community documentation reports a later rework affecting blockability; guard interaction therefore remains version-sensitive.
records.acquisition_notes: Hit's Initiation Test is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route. Hit's mentor listing places Flash Skewer among Hit's Super Pack 1 rewards.
records.pve_notes: Exact AI behavior and current quest-specific interactions are not independently verified.
records.pvp_notes: Historical community reports indicate balance changes to Flash Skewer; current frame data is not recorded here.
